question: Should OpenClaw add an agent-scoped web/tool credential override surface, and should it live under agents.list[].tools.web, plugin-owned per-agent config, or a unified credential model?
rationale: Source inspection proves the missing surface, but the fix changes credential isolation, SecretRef precedence, plugin ownership boundaries, and config compatibility, so automation cannot safely choose the permanent product/security contract.

options.title: Design unified credential contract
options.body: Keep this issue open and define one agent-scoped credential model that covers web tools, plugin-owned webSearch config, SecretRefs, validation, reload, docs, and tests before implementation.

options.title: Fold into plugin config design
options.body: Treat this as a subset of https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/55401 only if that design explicitly covers web-search/tool credential precedence and migration.

options.title: Decline per-agent tool credentials
options.body: Document separate gateways or external credential isolation as the supported boundary for distinct web-search billing/accounts, then close the feature direction manually.

recommendation.title: Design unified credential contract
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open and define one agent-scoped credential model that covers web tools, plugin-owned webSearch config, SecretRefs, validation, reload, docs, and tests before implementation.

likelyOwner.reason: This decision spans the config, SecretRef, runtime web-tool, and plugin-boundary surfaces where recent history points most strongly to this owner.
